entries.method: Pixel-level station replacement. Donor node scaled x0.9250 and translated (+11.1,+66.3) with nearest-neighbour resampling, masked to the union of both node silhouettes (dilated 3 px, holes filled, plinth tip extended), hard-edged; every pixel outside the mask is copied unchanged from icon 1.
entries.notes: Grindstone station = the lower-left / 8 o'clock node in both icons: each image's own generation prompt says so ('at lower-left one grindstone...' for icon 1; '8 o'clock grindstone...' for icon 2) and blender-b/render-command.json independently describes the approved icon 1 layout with the sixth, lower-left station as 'the reference grindstone'. A plinth-aligned 6x6 cross comparison of the two renders gives a perfect diagonal (icon1 slot <-> icon2 slot; the 8 o'clock pairing scores 21.8 MAD vs 31.7+ for every wrong pairing), so no slot was guessed and no permutation exists. Base edit box [48, 598, 414, 954] (lower-left node only; hub, the other six stations and all redstone spokes are outside it). Donor crop box [39, 574, 437, 961] in icon 2. Resample: nearest-neighbour, uniform scale 0.9250, offset (+11.1, +66.3) (fitted by maximising the plinth-footprint IoU; 0.71 at the optimum vs 0.46 at scale 1.0). Changed pixels: 56841 inside bbox [65, 604, 379, 929]; 0 pixels changed outside the edit box; 0 changed outside the lower-left node box. The node's content bbox is preserved exactly ([68, 617, 349, 929] -> [68, 608, 349, 925]) while carrying +1988 content px of the donor's grindstone. All 39824 clearly visible pixels of icon 1's lower-left node were replaced except 259 leftovers (all in the plinth's dark crevices at y 821-897, luma 42-66, against 70-160 for the cobblestone around them); the station above the plinth is 100% replaced and the 809 redstone-spoke pixels of the radial link are byte-identical to icon 1. Alignment caveat: the two grindstones are different renditions, so their silhouettes match at IoU 0.65-0.71, not exactly.
